# cursor-replay (vendored build)

Built output from the private library:

- Source: `https://github.com/gguatit/cursor-replay` (private)
- Version: `0.1.0`
- Files: `index.js`, `chunk-replay.js`, `index.d.ts`, `replay.d.ts`, `timeline.d.ts`

The Cue site is public, so the source repository is not a site dependency.
Only the compiled output is checked in here. Rebuild the library and copy the
new `dist` files when the library changes.

This is an independent clean-room implementation. It does not contain source
code, styles, SVG assets, sounds, text, or animation data from Swarm, Swarm
Rebuild, or Joel Califa. See the source repository's `NOTICE.md`.
